description: Diagnostic daemon to diagnose write_service heartbeat staleness (age=17m, threshold=300s). Per spec section 6, every daemon writes to service_health at least every 60s and stale >2h = dead. This daemon should SELECT current heartbeat from service_health WHERE service='write_service', compare against NOW(), and emit a diagnostic report. Must NOT propose rebuild of write_service.py (protected file). Output diagnostic findings only; if write_service is responsive via POST :8772/write, log healthy status and exit. Reference spec section 6 (Heartbeat contract).
